rule: flags.json (notes/task2/label_check/) is a list of grounding dev/test pair ids. Each newly flagged pair is replaced, in place, by the next candidate of its own set and type under the selection rule: the first item after the highest rank used so far (selected or flagged) in the saved item order whose image is unused, with the first valid unused partner in the saved partner order. Images of flagged pairs are never reused. The affected split files, images_val.json, mismatch_map.json and selection_report.json are rewritten, every assert is rerun, and splits/task2/label_flags.json records the flagged ids and their replacements. Flags already recorded are skipped, so rerunning is a no-op.
